notes.title: Madrid Noir : Emmy Awards Winner
notes.content:
[h1]🔎 ¡Hola todos! 🔎[/h1]

We are very excited to announce that Madrid Noir has won the Children's and Family Emmy Award for Outstanding Interactive Media !

All of us here at Astrea are very proud of this award and we believe that Atlas, No Ghost and James A. Castillo strongly deserve this recognittion for providing such a great work as a team !

We all hope the good news will keep coming so... Stay Tuned 👀
